title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization.We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey.

  • We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.
  • We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.
  • We're designing the future of autonomous marketing, taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do.

And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

About the role

We're expanding our Customer Success team and looking for a technically confident Customer Success Manager to partner with our Growth customers across the UK. You'll help brands grow with Bloomreach, get the most from Loomi and the wider product suite, to help turn their goals into measurable results.

What our customers achieve depends on how well their data, tracking and integrations are set up to deliver value across our product suite. You won't write integration code or build data pipelines (our consultancy services and partners do that), but you will need to understand how the platform works under the hood, read the data behind a customer's results, have an up to date understanding of the AI landscape - especially in Martech all to work out where our customers need to go next to get maximum value from their relationship with Bloomreach.

You'll own a named book of customers using multiple Bloomreach solutions, working within a modern engagement model that combines automated, self-serve and product-led experiences with 1:many programmes and targeted 1:1 sessions when a customer needs them most. You'll be the face of Bloomreach for these customers: a trusted advisor, industry expert, a source of ideas, and the person who understands their setup well enough to connect them with the right resources on our side. You will work remotely from the UK or from our London office.

The core of the role

These are the skills every CSM in the team uses week to week. We'll teach you Bloomreach, but we need you to bring the foundations.

  • Understand how customer data flows. Know how a customer's events, profiles and product catalogue data reaches Bloomreach (whether that be through web and mobile SDKs, APIs, imports, data warehouse connectors and our Data Hub) and understand how identity is stitched from anonymous visitor to known customer. Use that knowledge to sense-check a customer's setup and any spot gaps for technical experts to investigate before they limit results.
  • Read usage against entitlements. Interpret health, adoption and consumption data (monthly unique visitors, profiles, events, email and SMS volumes) against what a customer has contracted, and be able to explain what this usage means for our customers - are they trending ahead/behind or over and if so, why.
  • Triage problems properly. When something isn't working, work out whether it sits in the data, the configuration or the integration, gather the evidence, and route it to Support, consultancy or a partner with a clear, reproducible description or scope.
  • Explain the numbers. Build and interpret reporting on campaign revenue, conversion, average order value and customer lifetime value. When our numbers and the customer's analytics disagree, dig into tracking, attribution windows and methodology until you can explain the gap and ultimately the story behind the data and insights.
  • Know what's possible, and brief it well. Understand what the platform can do across segmentation, scenarios, channels, personalisation, recommendations and search, so you can recommend realistic use cases and write a clear brief when a Technical or Business Consultant needs to build them.
  • Use AI as a working tool. Use Loomi and other AI tools to analyse, research and draft, with the judgement to check and validate the output, and help customers put AI-driven capabilities to work in their own programmes.

Share your Knowledge. Whether it be industry insights, AI releases or use case utilisation, a CSM at Bloomreach should be keen to learn and share knowledge to their customers and colleagues alike. We will teach you Bloomreach but experience and interest in Martech, working with and experimenting with AI and agentic approaches will be key to your success.

What you will do

  • Own a named book of Growth customers. Act as each customer's designated CSM and main point of contact for adoption, value, satisfaction and the technical health of their setup.
  • Map Bloomreach to each customer's world. Understand their goals, pain points, data and tech stack, then translate these into clear recommendations and success plans that connect Bloomreach and Loomi capabilities to the outcomes they care about.
  • Be the ideas factory. Bring best practice, use-case inspiration and a point of view on what good looks like. Hand off hands-on configuration, implementation and campaign build to our consultancy services, partner network or Support, with a brief clear enough that work can start without a second round of questions.
  • Deliver engagement at scale. Host and facilitate 1:many programmes such as masterclasses, new-customer mini summits, webinars and customer events, alongside workshops, technical deep dives and consulting sessions for individual customers.
  • Read the signals. Monitor health, adoption, usage and data-quality signals across your book, spot risk and growth signals early, and share them promptly with your Account Manager counterpart.
  • Partner with Account Management. Work closely with Account Managers and Renewal Specialists, bringing adoption, value, usage and relationship context into account and renewal conversations. You own adoption, outcomes and retention; your Account Manager owns commercial growth and executive alignment. Together you make sure every customer experiences one joined-up Bloomreach team.
  • Champion the customer. Capture feedback for our Product teams, including technical gaps and limitations with the evidence behind them. Identify advocates and success stories, and contribute to the programmes, content and playbooks that help the whole segment succeed.

What success looks like

  • Customers' data and tracking are set up well enough to support the use cases they want to run, and gaps are spotted and resolved early.
  • Technical issues are triaged quickly and land with the right team to resolve these issues first time.
  • Customers understand how Bloomreach supports their goals and can see progress against them, backed by numbers they trust.
  • Adoption across the platform is healthy and growing, including adoption of new as well well as AI and Agentic-driven capabilities.
  • Customers engage with and value the programmes, events and resources available to them.
  • Risk and growth signals reach the right people early, and customers are retained and satisfied.

What you bring

Technical foundations

  • 2+ years in a customer-facing role in B2B SaaS, e-commerce, marketing technology or digital marketing, ideally as a CSM or Technical Account Manager, or in solutions, implementation, martech operations or agency delivery, where you sat between marketers and technical teams.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one marketing automation, ESP or CDP platform (Bloomreach, Klaviyo, Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, HubSpot, Marketo, Emarsys or similar), plus an understanding of the commerce data behind it (catalogue, cart, purchase) from platforms such as Shopify, BigCommerce or Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
  • Working knowledge of web tracking and data integration: how events and identifiers are captured, what APIs and data feeds do, and how consent affects what can be tracked.
  • Comfortable with exploring data: Knowledge of SQL or strong spreadsheet skills to sanity-check a number, and familiarity with an analytics or BI tool such as GA4, Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Amplitude or Mixpanel.
  • A working understanding of marketing attribution (last-touch versus multi-touch, lookback windows) and customer segmentation (RFM, cohort, lifecycle).
  • A structured approach to problem-solving: when two systems disagree, you find out why rather than explain it away.

Customer and consulting skills

  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills: you build trust and rapport quickly, keep relationships strong when much of the engagement is remote, digital or in group settings, and earn credibility with stakeholders from day-to-day practitioners to senior leaders.
  • The ability to quickly understand a customer's business model, priorities and KPIs, and to map solutions to their goals and challenges.
  • Confident presentation and facilitation skills, including explaining technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences, from a single-customer workshop to a room or virtual audience.
  • Strong organisation and prioritisation, with the judgement to know where your time will have the most impact across a varied book of customers.
  • Good judgement on when to bring in specialists, and the collaboration skills to work smoothly with Account Management, consultancy, partners, Support and Product.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of a templating language (Jinja, Liquid, AMPscript or Handlebars); basic HTML and CSS for email and web; a customer success platform such as Gainsight; or experience supporting a platform implementation or migration.

More things you'll like about Bloomreach:

Culture:

  • A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one.

  • We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication.

  • We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style.

  • We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across

 Mercury is building a complete finance stack for startups. Since we launched Mercury in 2019, our customer base has grown to over 300,000 startups and small businesses from all around the world. With growth comes the need to ensure our customer experience is top of mind even in the most challenging scenarios.

 We’re working to build something like magic for a really wide range of startup businesses. A key piece of the magic we’ve built thus far has been smart, product-driven support, and we’re looking to bring on an operational-focused, thoughtful Support Manager to help us continuously improve our Risk Support experience as we scale quickly.

 You’ll join as the second manager on our Risk Support team, partnering closely with an existing Risk Support Manager to execute the operational function of the team and support the wider strategic vision. You’ll manage your own cohort of specialists who are dedicated to managing customer interactions and operational tasks across key risk-related workstreams. You’ll collaborate with multiple Risk teams at Mercury, including AML, Fraud, ODD, Onboarding, Sanctions, and Risk UX, to provide clear, thoughtful, and accurate support systems to help customers impacted by risk-related decisions or processes.

 Beyond your own team, you’ll help run a growing Risk Support operation: scoping and executing our BPO partnership strategy for Risk Support, and expanding newer programs like proactive outreach and VIP/managed support. You’ll also work closely with our engineering, design, business operations, and compliance teams to improve our product and customer-facing processes.

 This is a fincrime-oriented , CX-first operational support leadership role that connects the customer experience to Mercury’s internal risk infrastructure.

 Your Role:

• Lead & Develop: Hire, mentor, and manage a customer support team that excels in product knowledge, user support, and the US banking* system

• Partner in Leadership: Work hand-in-hand with our existing Risk Support Manager to set team strategy, align on standards and processes, share coverage, and keep both cohorts operating as one consistent Risk Support team

• BPO Partnership: Help scope and manage our new Risk Support BPO partner, including onboarding and training, quality assurance, performance and SLA tracking, capacity planning, and deciding what work is right to route to the partner vs. keep in-house

• Program Expansion: Grow and scale newer programs like proactive outreach (reaching users before a Risk request becomes a blocker) and VIP/managed support for high-touch customers, defining the playbooks, staffing, and success metrics for each

• Performance Management & Development: Own team performance management by setting clear goals, tracking key metrics, and driving continuous improvement across your team and our BPO partner. Foster a culture of continuous learning and professional growth within your team, providing regular feedback and coaching

• Process Improvements, AI & Automation : Refine and evolve our support processes, building workflows that drive efficiency and effectiveness across the organization including AI tools and automation to make Risk Support faster and more effective. Take ideas from pilot to production while keeping every workflow within our compliance, privacy, and regulatory standards

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with compliance, engineering, product, and banking partners to resolve complex issues, improve our product based on Customer Support interactions, and implement changes that make for a better customer experience

• Customer Advocacy: Champion our customers by advocating for their needs with data-driven insights and compelling narratives

• Hands-On Leadership: Be ready to dive into tickets alongside your team during peak times or critical issues, be a sounding board for escalations, and help wherever the team needs as a leader on the front lines

 What we’re looking for:

• 3+ years of experience leading customer support or other Risk user-facing teams, preferably in high-growth technology companies

• A strong familiarity or expertise supporting KYC, KYB, AML processes and other regulatory requirements

• A collaborative leadership style and comfort sharing ownership of a function with a peer manager

• Expertise in adding structure for support teams growing quickly

• Enjoyment in teaching and mentoring others on how to become really skilled at support

• Previous experience partnering cross-functionally with engineering, product, risk, and compliance teams

• Comfort navigating data visualization tools (Omni, Metabase, etc.)

• Experience managing complex operational projects that affect multiple teams

• Consistent empathy while helping entrepreneurs build successful businesses

• The ability to break down hard problems into clear, understandable pieces, and to use data to drive decisions (even when the data is not perfect)

• A penchant to question the first answer, and enjoyment in going levels deeper to find all the edge cases

• Rigor when designing new processes, and a high bar for the quality of your work

• Creativity while working within difficult constraints

 The ideal candidate may also have:

• Experience managing or partnering with a BPO or outsourced support vendor, including quality programs, SLAs, and vendor performance management

• Experience building or scaling proactive support, VIP, or high-touch/managed support programs (a plus)

title: Engineering Manager, Knowledge Graph Platform
description:
Headquarters: Remote - United States

 Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

 Who We Are:

 The Knowledge Graph Platform team builds the foundational systems that help Reddit understand entities, relationships, and context across its content. We are evolving an advanced, AI-powered knowledge graph into a reliable, scalable platform that enables teams across Reddit to build better experiences on top of shared, high-quality knowledge.

 This is a high-leverage team at the intersection of data, platform engineering, and AI. Our work supports emerging capabilities such as contextual grounding while creating the contracts, standards, and developer experience that make shared data dependable and easy to use. This team is strategically positioned to impact both ads and consumer roadmaps. Our data is used across ads marketplace models as well as user-facing features on reddit.com .

 What You’ll Do:

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers building Reddit’s Knowledge Graph Platform; create a high-trust, high-performing environment with clear goals and strong technical ownership.

• Set the technical direction and roadmap for a scalable knowledge graph platform, including data and API contracts, service interfaces, reliability, observability, performance, and developer experience.

• Leverage SOTA LLM and agentic patterns for knowledge graph construction.

• Establish production-grade operating standards: defining SLOs, implementing quality measures of data within the knowledge graph, governance mechanisms, and safe change-management practices.

• Partner with engineering, computational linguists, and domain-expert teams to define a shared operating model for ontology, data quality, governance, and platform evolution.

• Be a steward of data in the KG - ensure the graph has the coverage and freshness needed for priority use cases. Work with our dedicated data labeler team on shared goals around data coverage and quality.

• Work closely with internal product and engineering teams to understand their needs, prioritize high-value use cases, and increase access to the platform.

• Drive the next wave of graph-powered capabilities, including opportunities in shopping, search, ads marketplace models, consumer feed models.

• Stay close to architecture and technical design, helping the team navigate complex system tradeoffs and contribute hands-on when it is the highest-leverage path.

• Communicate the team’s strategy, priorities, risks, and progress clearly across a distributed, cross-functional organization.

 Who You Might Be:

• 8+ years of total software engineering experience, with 2+ years directly managing, coaching, and developing engineering teams.

• Experience with knowledge graphs, semantic or ontology systems, entity resolution, search, or contextual grounding is highly desired.

• Experience building or operating AI/ML powered, or data-intensive platforms, with a proven track record of leading shared technical systems with multiple internal customers.

• Strong understanding of how to turn a technical system into a product-like platform: setting an operating model with customers, establishing data or service-level contracts, useful documentation, and a path to self-service adoption.

• Experience establishing data contracts around quality, lineage, or governance.

• Strong technical judgment across distributed systems, backend services, data platforms, APIs, reliability, and operational excellence.

• Comfortable making technical and product tradeoffs in ambiguity, including when a dedicated product manager is not present.

• Excellent collaborator and communicator who can earn trust with engineers, senior leaders, and partner teams across time zones.

• Enjoy building clarity and durable operating mechanisms where ownership and processes are still evolving. Excel in evangelization and driving platform adoption cross org.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

• Master’s or Advanced Degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computational Linguistics, or a related field.

 The successful candidate will turn a complex global relationship into a focused, repeatable growth engine—aligning executives, mobilizing Ping’s teams, and helping Accenture make Ping the identity platform of choice in strategic transformation programs.

 This is a hands-on builder role. You will craft the strategy, create the operating model, and drive execution from executive alignment through customer outcomes. You will build top-down and bottoms-up engagement and convert shared priorities into strategic collaboration agreements, joint investment plans, and measurable results.

 What you will own

 Global alliance strategy and executive leadership

• Define and execute a multi-year global Accenture alliance strategy aligned to Ping’s corporate priorities, growth objectives, product strategy, and regional plans.

• Establish trusted relationships with Accenture’s global and regional executives across Identity, Cybersecurity, Technology, Song, cloud, industry, delivery, and managed services.

• Act as Ping’s primary global Accenture leadership point and orchestrate executive alignment when priorities, resources, commercial interests, or customer pursuits require senior intervention.

• Build and maintain a joint annual business plan with clear priorities, investments, owners, milestones, and measurable outcomes.

 Strategic engagement and collaboration agreements

• Build a deliberate, multi-threaded engagement model with Accenture’s global leadership, practice executives, industry leaders, regional sponsors, account executives, and delivery leaders.

• Develop, advance, and operationalize strategic collaboration agreements, memoranda of understanding, annual business plans, and related partnership frameworks with Accenture.

• Translate agreements into clear gives-and-gets, governance structures, named owners, investment principles, milestones, escalation paths, and measurable success criteria.

• Partner with Ping Finance, Legal, Operations, Product, Sales, Sales Engineering, Professional Services, and executive leadership to ensure agreements are commercially sound, executable, and connected to Ping’s broader strategy.

• Establish a cadence of executive briefings, steering committees, business reviews, and working sessions that keeps both organizations aligned and accountable.

• Identify when a relationship should progress from informal collaboration to a formal strategic agreement, and lead the internal and partner process required to make that progression successful.

 Joint go-to-market and revenue growth

• Develop a disciplined joint go-to-market motion spanning “to,” “with,” and “through” Accenture partner routes.

• Build and manage a prioritized target-account strategy, including account mapping, install-base intelligence, whitespace analysis, opportunity hypotheses, and executive sponsorship.

• Mobilize Ping account teams and Accenture sales, account, industry, and practice leaders around qualified opportunities and strategic pursuits.

• Drive partner-sourced, partner-influenced, co-sell, resale, services-attach, and expansion revenue while establishing clear definitions for attribution and credit.

• Create repeatable joint offers and sales plays that connect Ping’s identity security platform with Accenture’s consulting, implementation, transformation, and managed-services capabilities.

• Improve pipeline quality, progression, forecast accuracy, win rates, deal velocity, and strategic account penetration through consistent inspection and action planning.

• Ensure that the partnership produces referenceable customer outcomes—not only activity, meetings, or enablement attendance.

 Governance, operating rhythm, and accountability

• Establish a practical governance model with executive sponsorship, a named steering committee, working teams, escalation paths, and clear decision rights.

• Lead monthly operating reviews, quarterly business reviews, and annual planning sessions with Ping and Accenture executives.

• Maintain a shared scorecard covering pipeline, bookings, revenue, services attach, target-account engagement, enablement, certifications, delivery capacity, joint offers, lighthouse customers, customer outcomes, and referenceability.

• Convert strategic intent into 30-, 60-, and 90-day execution plans with named owners and measurable milestones.

• Identify execution gaps early, make trade-offs explicit, and hold both organizations accountable for commitments.

• Partner with Finance, Legal, Operations, and leadership teams to establish sound commercial, investment, compliance, and reporting practices.

 Enablement, delivery, and customer success

• Work with the partner enablement team to build a scalable enablement strategy for Accenture sales, solution architects, consultants, and delivery professionals.

• Align Ping Professional Services, Customer Success, Sales Engineering, Product, Support, Enablement and other partner delivery resources to improve implementation quality, customer outcomes, and feedback loops.

• Connect enablement to pipeline, pursuits, implementations, services attach, and customer outcomes.

• Set targets, identify gaps, coordinate Ping resources, and report progress through alliance governance and quarterly business reviews.

 Cross-functional leadership inside Ping

• Serve as Accenture’s connective tissue between Global Alliances and Sales, Sales Engineering, Product, Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Professional Services, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and Operations.

• Create clarity on roles, resources, pursuit strategy, deal engagement, channel conflict, commercial guardrails, and escalation paths.

• Champion partner-led execution across Ping’s global field organization and make it easy for sellers to understand when and how to engage Accenture.

• Represent the voice of Accenture internally while protecting Ping’s strategic, customer, commercial, and operational interests.

• Build a culture of ownership, transparency, urgency, and measurable execution across the virtual alliance team.

 What success looks like

 Success will be measured by:

• An adopted global strategy, strong executive relationships, and effective governance.

• Strategic collaboration agreements with clear mutual commitments, investments, and outcomes.

• Growth in qualified pipeline, bookings, revenue, and services attach for both Ping and Accenture.

• A measurable Accenture enablement and delivery capability, supported by training, certifications, and capacity.

• Stronger field execution, forecast discipline, new logos, renewals and referenceable outcomes.

 What you bring

• Experience building and managing strategic relationships with Accenture, ideally across global or regional practices.

• Experience in cybersecurity; experience with identity is a strong plus.

• Experience building and scaling programs—from strategy and operating model through enablement, execution, and measurement.

• International experience working across regions, cultures, and complex global organizations.

title: Global Technical Talent Lead
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for a Global Technical Talent Lead to own hiring across Engineering, Product, Design, Research, and Growth worldwide. Reporting to the Head of Talent, you will lead Talent leaders and partner with senior engineering, growth, and research leaders to build the teams powering ElevenLabs. Your mandate is to bring cohesion to hiring strategy, execution, and standards across this portfolio, with accountability for hiring quality, pace, and predictability.

  • Turn engineering priorities into a deliverable global hiring plan. Partner with functional leaders to translate product roadmaps, research priorities, and workforce plans into hiring plans. Own Talent capacity allocation, planning, forecasting, and reporting.

  • Build and lead a cohesive global recruiting organization. Coach and develop Talent leaders, establish clear accountability for results, and allocate resources across disciplines and markets as priorities change. Build shared practices for talent mapping, sourcing, candidate experience, and closing while developing the specialist expertise each talent market requires.

  • Define and uphold the hiring bar across technical disciplines. Partner with functional leaders to define excellence by role and level, translating it into clear success profiles, rigorous assessment, and consistent hiring decisions. Equip the team to engage exceptional talent, credibly represent the work, and help candidates understand the opportunity and impact.

  • Make hiring performance visible and predictable. Establish regular hiring reviews with functional and senior leadership to track delivery, surface risks, and resolve decisions. Use market intelligence and funnel data to advise on location strategy, skill availability, and interviewer capacity. Partner with Talent Ops to improve systems, tools, processes, and the use of AI, so hiring is demonstrably faster and more efficient.

Requirements

  • You have led Talent through hypergrowth at a company that grew 3x or more in two years, owning delivery of hundreds to thousands of hires annually across multiple regions and time zones. You have a proven track record of managing teams of Talent leaders and delivering business critical hiring across engineering, research, growth, design, and product disciplines.

  • You can earn the trust of senior engineering, growth, product, design, and research leaders, partner on hiring decisions, and advise on talent availability, location, role scope, and assessment. You have deep expertise in the varying talent markets.

  • You have translated changing business and technical priorities into credible hiring forecasts and recruiting capacity plans. You use pipeline, conversion, hiring lead times, and interviewer capacity to distinguish achievable commitments from emerging risks and guide resource decisions.

  • You combine strong people leadership with deep recruiting expertise. You have raised team performance through coaching, partnered with hiring leaders to improve assessments, and maintained a high hiring bar at scale. You can personally unblock a difficult search or help close an exceptional candidate.

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. Preference for candidates based in US East or GMT timezones.

title: Engineering Manager - UK
description:
Hi I’m Colin, Director of Engineering, Europe. How do you feel about software engineers writing product specs, making product decisions, and not breaking down projects into individual tickets? If that sounds exciting (even if a bit scary), read on because I’m looking for an engineering manager to help us build a different type of engineering team and culture at Ashby.

To start, why do we need to be different? Time and again, I have witnessed engineers knowing what needs to be done yet being unable to get things done because of “the process” or because “more data is needed.” Some of the most effective projects have been skunkworks projects, where engineers have taken total ownership of a problem and driven it to completion. I want to normalize that at Ashby.

When we think about how these processes came about, we realize they carry a pessimistic mindset. They box people into smaller roles to minimize the chance of not meeting a certain standard. At Ashby. we’re building an environment that is optimistic about what engineers can own and achieve and embraces the innovative engineers (and frankly, often stays out of their way).

To accomplish this, our engineering leaders need to think deeply about individual performance, process, and culture - not running sprint planning or driving product and technical decisions. You’ll focus on building your team, their skills to thrive with the ownership they’re given, and an environment that empowers them to do their best work consistently, with little distraction. For junior EMs we try to stay within 6 direct reports. This enables them to spend time with our teams observing, correcting, praising, and, yes, coding. We like our managers to be hands-on while also making sure they’re not on the critical path.

We’ve already gathered an experienced, talented, and collaborative team of 25+ engineers. You’ll help me manage the growing team of engineers in Europe.

In addition to working with engineers you’ll also get to work on projects yourselves. Some examples of work our engineering leaders have done:

  • Provide feedback on product and technical specs to help engineers identify where to cut scope or improve quality. You don’t make the final decisions, but you’ll influence and coach ICs to reach the right ones.

  • Grow engineers to the point where they can take large, loosely defined projects, and deliver them with little intervention. They still ask for help when needed - the difference is that they’re driving.

  • Jump into our systems and code to debug a customer issue, ship a small bug fix, or improve our developer experience. Engineering leaders at Ashby are great engineers and enjoy keeping their skills up-to-date (while staying off the critical path).

  • Improve how we generate and simulate data in demo accounts. It’s a project off the critical path, but it helps you keep up-to-date on our codebase while immensely impacting the business, from Engineering to QA to Sales.

Why be a manager?

I had two experiences early in my career that set me on my path. I had a great manager who asked tonnes of questions about the decisions I was making and coached me without me realizing it. And I had a terrible manager - being told to work harder after a week of 3am finishes was not what I needed as a young engineer. The stark difference between these two experiences motivated me to become a manager: I wanted every engineer I worked with to have the support I had in the best case.

Since then, as I’ve learned more, I’ve realized that I love the kind of problems I get to solve as a manager. Deeply complex problems with long-term impact both on the company and on people’s lives. One of my proudest achievements is creating a fully transparent pay system, and on the day it was revealed, everybody was happy with it. Nobody stormed out. By spending time thinking deeply about everybody’s pay and ensuring the mechanics of promotion were clear, I put the team in a place where they could see a peer was paid more than them, and it not be a problem.

Despite all this, I love being technical. I sometimes indulge myself and spend a morning writing some code to improve tests or provide better abstractions. If I couldn’t be a manager, I’d be super happy to be an IC.

I’m looking for someone who is passionate. Passionate about both management and being technical. Someone who spots a pattern amongst their team, figures out a better way for us to operate, and then builds the automation that powers it. I introduced a new process that enables engineers to merge 30% of PRs without a human review beforehand. I also built the automation that approves these PRs. I also built that automation with abstractions that make it easy for the engineers to improve the automation themselves.

It can be hard to find seasoned engineering leaders who haven’t succumbed to the status quo in some way or another. We're committed to giving all our people a total and utter lack of terrible managers, and that means we're willing to take a chance on someone early in their leadership journey who's courageous, principled, and has the drive to build themselves into a great leader who can say “Yah I know everyone is doing that, but we won't because...”

Why You Should or Shouldn’t Apply

Engineering leadership comes in many flavors, not all of which fit our model. I thought I’d outline some things I’m looking for to help you decide if this fits what you’re looking for:

  • You love being technical and can hold in-depth conversations with direct reports from infra to backend to frontend.

  • You enjoy management problems. We want people who get excited about driving people to be their best, giving difficult feedback, and building systems that make this easier

  • You hold your team to a high standard and don’t shy away from getting into the details and giving feedback, even to the best folks on your team.

  • You are an excellent and empathetic communicator. Facilitating change at both an individual and organization level requires understanding how to navigate the beliefs, opinions, and past experiences of engineers and figuring out how to both convince them of a new way of doing things while also leaving yourself open to feedback.

  • You know what exceptional engineers look like. You’ve thought deeply about what makes them tick, how to recruit them, and how to grow folks into them. I want to see depth here, the industry often regurgitates a vanilla description, but the reality is more nuanced.

  • You’re good at thinking about product, business, and maybe even design, but you’re not interested in calling the shots and are more interested in building a team that can make the best decisions without you.

  • You thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments. We're a young startup where leaders wear multiple hats, and you'll build your own (high-speed) on-ramp through developing strong feedback loops.

Put another way, you shouldn’t apply if:

  • You don’t enjoy coding or don’t find time to stay up-to-date on technology.

  • You’ve gotten into management because it was the only growth path available

  • You want to make all the product decisions instead of empowering your team to make those calls.

  • You're happy with a team of engineers that are predominantly early-career, mid-career, or don't thrive with ownership or autonomy. With enough guardrails, the team can get things done.

  • A staff or principal engineer to you is someone who spends most of their time project managing or doing architecture reviews.

  • You’re not optimistic or convinced that we can build a large engineering team that functions differently than the status quo. You think, at some size, common processes need to be implemented to ensure consistent product delivery (e.g., sprint planning, product managers writing in-depth specifications). You might not say it out loud, but you think, at some size, compromises have to be made for the sake of hiring numbers.

What We’re Building

Talent teams aspire to build a hiring process that identifies great candidates, moves them quickly through the interview process, and provides an excellent experience for the candidate. To accomplish this, recruiters perform thousands of daily tasks to coordinate and relay information between candidates, interviewers, and hiring managers. Teams struggle to keep up!

Scheduling a final round is an excellent example of our customers' challenges. A recruiter needs to collect availability from the candidate, identify potential interviewers, perform “Calendar Tetris” to find who is available to interview the candidate, schedule on the earliest date possible, and perform any last-minute adjustments as availability changes. They must perform this while considering the interview load on each individual and whether interviewers need to be trained and shadowing others.

Ashby provides talent teams with intelligent and powerful software that provides insights into where they’re failing and automates or simplifies many of the tasks they’re underwater with. We put a lot of effort into designing products that are approachable to beginners but mastered and extended by power users. In many ways, spreadsheets set the bar here.

We have many customers, great revenue growth, years of runway, and amazing investors like YCombinator, Elad Gil, and Lachy Groom. I’ll share more once we meet.

Engineering Culture

Our engineering culture is motivated by Abhik and Benji’s (our co-founders) belief that a small talented team, given the right environment, can build high-quality software fast (and work regular hours!).

Collaboration is Natural, Communication is Deliberate

Our engineering team (and the team at large) consists of lifelong learners who are humble and kind (meet them here!). These attributes create an environment where collaboration happens naturally (we filter for it in interviews). We combine this with research, prototyping, and written proposals to see around corners and get feedback from the team across time zones. Focus time is something that we hold sacred, and, with thoughtful and deliberate communication, engineers can focus 36h out of a 40h work week (Abhik wrote about it here). Even managers can rely on getting consistent time (and support to make, if necessary) to focus and do creative work without the demand of constant meetings.

Increase Leverage, not Team Size

We built Ashby with the quality, breadth, and depth that many customers would expect from much larger teams over larger time scales. We’ve done this through investment in:

title: Trust EHCP Coordinator
description:
Swale Academies Trust is seeking a dedicated Trust EHCP Coordinator (HLTA Level) to join our team. In this targeted capacity role, you will work under the direction of the Trust SEND Lead to provide crucial administrative and operational support across primary and secondary Trust schools.

- Maintain complete working knowledge of the SEND Code of Practice and local authority criteria to ensure legal alignment.

- GCSE English and Maths (or equivalent) at grade C/4 or above.

- Level 2 or 3 Diploma (or equivalent) and working at or towards HLTA professional standards.

- Proven experience navigating the EHCP application process and compiling statutory assessment paperwork.

- Experience working with children within a learning environment.

- Solid working knowledge of the SEND Code of Practice, local authority processes, and high-incidence SEND need types.

- Exceptional written communication skills for drafting precise, legally defensible reports.

- Strong organisational skills, initiative, and the ability to manage multiple complex cases under strict statutory deadlines.

And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

The Strategic Account Executive is a field-based position with ownership of an assigned territory in the Middle East region focused on net new logo opportunities. You will have the ability to utilize a robust internal resource model, a broad tech stack, and a global partner directory to position yourself for future success.

We will consider applicants based in the UK or France only

You will:

  • Create, implement, measure and review a personal plan that drives achievement of performance goals aligned to the regional sales strategy.
  • Position and articulate our value proposition to customers to maximize the business opportunity.
  • Negotiate and close complex contracts with the support of global partners.

  • Provides customer feedback to marketing, customer success, product management, and engineering teams.
  • Work collaboratively to acquire additional/specialist resources as needed.

You have:

  • Demonstrable, successful experience of selling in the Middle East region
  • Proven experience of winning multiple new logo deals of $150k+ ARR and exceeding quota
  • A results-oriented mindset with proven ability to conduct effective account/territory planning & pipeline generation
  • Sustainable record of signing strategic and large projects, with long and complex sales cycles.
  • Established sector-related C level contacts.
  • Successful record dealing with strategic buyers.
  • Deep knowledge of the relevant key drivers of change in the industry.
  • Background working with regional/national/global partners and system integrators.
  • Prior training and experience in value selling and account planning methodologies.
  • Eligibility to work in the UK or France.

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. As Risk Manager, you will lead the identification, assessment, treatment, monitoring, and reporting of information security and business risks across Ping Identity. You will partner with stakeholders across Enterprise Security, Engineering, Product, Legal, Privacy, People Team, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance to maintain and continuously improve Ping Identity’s risk management practices and supporting governance. Your work will connect enterprise risk management with the Information Security Management System (ISMS), Business Continuity Management System (BCMS), AI Management System (AIMS), control environment, customer assurance capability, and audit readiness.

You will balance strong risk oversight with pragmatic execution, helping the organisation understand its most material risks, make informed trade-offs, and track risk treatment through to measurable resolution. You will also contribute to a scalable operating model through clear governance routines, useful metrics, effective stakeholder engagement, and continuous improvement.

What You’ll Do

You will:

  • Run and continuously improve the information security risk management lifecycle, including risk identification, assessment, prioritisation, treatment, acceptance, monitoring, and reporting.

  • Run enterprise, business-unit, project, technology, and third-party risk assessments, ensuring risks are evaluated consistently and documented with clear business context.

  • Maintain risk registers, risk statements, treatment plans, action owners, due dates, and escalation paths, ensuring material risks remain visible and actively managed.

  • Define and monitor risk appetite, tolerance indicators, key risk indicators, and management reporting that support timely decision-making by security and business leadership.

  • Advise senior leaders and control owners on risk acceptance, mitigation options, compensating controls, residual risk, and escalation requirements.

  • Partner with control owners and business stakeholders to improve control design, evidence quality, remediation effectiveness, and the connection between controls and material risks.

  • Maintain and improve the ISMS, BCMS, and AIMS risk components, including policies, standards, procedures, risk methodologies, control mappings, and governance records.

  • Coordinate risk-related inputs to internal and external audits, customer assurance activities, regulatory requests, and security questionnaires.

  • Oversee third-party and supplier risk activities, including inherent risk assessments, due diligence, risk treatment, ongoing monitoring, issue management, and exception handling.

  • Establish governance routines, workflows, playbooks, service levels, and escalation processes that improve risk visibility, consistency, and operational efficiency.

  • Track remediation and risk treatment commitments, challenge weak or overdue actions, and provide clear reporting on trends, dependencies, and residual exposure.

  • Use operational data and metrics to identify systemic issues, improve programme performance, and demonstrate the effectiveness of risk management activities.

  • Act as an escalation point for complex or ambiguous risk matters and help stakeholders reach practical, defensible, and appropriately documented decisions.

  • Contribute to the development of GRC and Information Security team capability through coaching, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.

What We’re Looking For

You have:

  • Demonstrable experience leading information security risk assessments and treatment programmes in a complex, technology-led organisation.

  • Experience with and understanding of recognised compliance frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, NIST, HIPAA, or similar, and their relationship with enterprise risk.

  • Strong understanding of security and technology risks across systems, networks, applications, cloud services, identity platforms, and business processes.

  • Experience working with cloud environments such as AWS, GCP, or Azure and the ability to translate technical issues into business risk.

  • Experience with risk registers, risk acceptance, exception management, remediation tracking, control validation, and residual-risk reporting.

  • Experience working with internal and external auditors, control owners, executive stakeholders, and cross-functional delivery teams.

  • Experience with third-party or supplier risk management, including due diligence, contractual risk considerations, and ongoing oversight.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor risk narratives for technical teams, auditors, executives, customers, and other stakeholders.

  • Strong judgement, prioritisation, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills, especially in ambiguous or cross-functional situations.

  • The ability to challenge constructively, influence without direct authority, and build trust while maintaining appropriate risk discipline.

  • Experience using metrics, data, and operational reporting to improve risk visibility and programme effectiveness.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Experience developing enterprise risk reporting, key risk indicators, risk appetite statements, or risk committee materials.

  • Experience leading customer assurance or security questionnaire programmes.

  • Experience with GRC, risk, audit, or compliance platforms and workflow automation.

  • Experience improving risk assessment, evidence collection, control testing, or reporting through automation.

  • Experience working in a SaaS, cloud, identity, or software development environment.

  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, CGEIT, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor.

  • Experience partnering closely with Legal, Sales, Privacy, Engineering, Product, Finance, and Procurement on security and compliance risks.

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day.

description:

This role goes beyond delivering demos - you’ll own the evaluation experience end-to-end, influence key stakeholders, and help drive successful outcomes across enterprise accounts.

  • Own the technical explanation behind consumption movement in your accounts. Work with the CSM and TAM to separate legitimate growth from misconfiguration, make sure legitimate growth gets quantified before renewal, and flag forward-looking usage the customer has signalled rather than explaining it backwards a month later.

  • Drive operational excellence by ensuring activity, deal progress, and customer interactions are accurately documented and up to date in related systems

title: Manager, EMEA Community (Contract)
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

This contract engagement is open to candidates based in the UK as a fixed-term leave cover.

We are seeking a strategic community management professional to join our International Community Team, and lead a growing team in EMEA. As the Manager of Community for EMEA, you will spearhead the development and execution of the community strategy that supports Reddit’s growth in the region.

In this role, you will lead a team of Community Specialists and will take charge of defining the roadmap for community activation and moderation across focus markets, and help develop our international playbook.

Your work will focus on experimenting, iterating, and refining processes that drive community engagement at scale. The insights you generate through these efforts will accelerate Reddit’s growth in EMEA, and serve as a model for other emerging markets. This role reports to the Director, International Community.

Responsibilities:

  • Craft and champion the regional community strategy, ensuring alignment with overall team and business goals.
  • Drive the iteration, innovation, and scaling of the community and moderator growth playbook, proactively identifying new opportunities and launching bold initiatives in key markets.
  • Inspire and empower regional teams to execute impactful programs that elevate local communities, and their markets. Encourage innovation and create an environment of continuous learning and improvement.
  • Recruit, onboard, and train local community specialists in key markets to strengthen our collaboration with moderators and drive community engagement.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Growth, Product, Engineering, etc.) to ensure successful alignment and execution of new initiatives.
  • Gather regional insights and learnings, and effectively report results to various internal stakeholders.
  • Lead, coach and develop the regional team; translate strategy into quarterly and sprint priorities, clear ownership and milestones; review risks and capacity, and unblock delivery
  • Own community-health and growth outcomes across priority markets, including KPI progression, moderator coverage and retention, and the impact of community-building initiatives.
  • Coordinate with Content, Growth, Product and relevant safety partners to deliver market initiatives and surface local needs for broader roadmap decisions.

Required qualifications:

  • 5-7 years of experience in community management or marketing operations, including at least 1-2 years in a leadership role, with a proven track record of driving community growth and delivering business impact through community-led or marketing projects.
  • Organized with a strong ability to balance strategic thinking with operational execution.
  • Problem-solver with excellent interpersonal skills, capable of collaborating with diverse cross-functional teams and influencing them to adopt a community-first mindset.
  • Comfortable testing, iterating, and adjusting strategies to find the optimal approach for each market.
  • Skilled at navigating ambiguous environments and experimenting with different approaches to achieve results in focus markets.
  • Data-driven and results-oriented, with a keen ability to translate insights into action.
  • Deep understanding of Reddit’s unique identity, and the critical role communities and moderators play in adding value to the platform and enhancing user experiences.

Bonus Points

    • Experience in moderation on Reddit or similar platforms (e.g., Discord, Facebook, or other forums).

title: Staff Product Designer - Platform Design
description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

Spotify runs on the tools we've built for ourselves. They help hundreds of teams ship every day to hundreds of millions of people around the world. Now, we're sharing them.

Spotify Technology brings our proven tools and services together for engineering organisations everywhere, from global enterprises to individual developers. As AI reshapes how software gets made, we're building on years of experience solving complex engineering challenges at scale.

Platform Design makes these powerful tools feel effortless. We shape the services, products and experiences used by Spotify's engineering teams and by developers around the world. We believe great design is a competitive advantage, and developer tools deserve the same care and craft as any consumer product.

As a Staff Product Designer, you'll combine product leadership with hands-on design and engineering. You'll shape the experience strategy for a key part of the Spotify Technology portfolio, establish a distinctive visual language, and turn internal tools into products customers love using. You'll work closely with product, engineering and marketing partners, reporting to the Spotify Technology Design Director.

What You'll Do

  • Lead complex design challenges from early exploration through to production, creating intuitive flows, interfaces, interactions and motion that make powerful developer tools easier to use.
  • Shape the visual language of Spotify Technology, bringing consistency, personality and craft across product experiences and brand touchpoints.
  • Transform tools built for Spotify's engineering teams into compelling commercial products that meet the needs of developers and enterprise customers.
  • Bring design to life in code, building and shipping high-quality front-end experiences with close attention to performance, accessibility and detail.
  • Set experience strategy across your product area, partnering with product and engineering leaders to influence priorities, guide decisions and shape the roadmap.
  • Use prototypes, storytelling and experimentation to make complex ideas tangible, build alignment and help teams navigate trade-offs.
  • Explore how generative AI and agentic tools can improve design and development workflows, while creating thoughtful experiences for products used by people and AI agents.
  • Raise the bar for design craft across the team, championing design systems, inclusive experiences and a culture of collaboration, feedback and continuous learning.

Who You Are

  • You have a strong background in product design, with experience shaping complex digital products and delivering high-quality visual and interaction design.
  • You're comfortable working across strategy and execution, setting a clear product direction while staying close to the details of design and delivery.
  • You can build and ship user interfaces using a modern front-end technology stack, and enjoy bringing your designs into production.
  • You understand how to create cohesive visual experiences across product and brand, with a thoughtful approach to interaction, motion and design systems.
  • You bring an understanding of developer tools, enterprise software or platform products, including the challenges of designing for technical audiences.
  • You use generative AI and agentic tools in your work, applying sound judgement about where they add value and where human expertise matters most.
  • You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, using research, data and customer insights to make informed decisions and solve complex problems.
  • You communicate ideas clearly, build trust across disciplines and influence product decisions through compelling design work and storytelling.
  • You care about helping others grow, welcome different perspectives and contribute to an inclusive, collaborative environment where great work can happen.

Where You'll Be

  • This role is based in London, UK or Stockholm, Sweden
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Compensation

title: Product Manager - Data Platform
description:
Spotify’s mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators.

Data is a means to an end, and Spotify extracts value from data through application. The Data Platform Studio helps Spotify win by enabling the application of data in an intuitive and efficient way.

Data Platform is responsible for how data is collected, processed, stored, governed, and made available to the thousands of engineers, data scientists, analysts, and machine learning practitioners who build Spotify’s products. As AI agents increasingly generate code, write data pipelines, and power personalized user experiences, Data Platform sits at the center of one of the most important infrastructure domains at Spotify.

We're looking for a passionate Product Manager to join the team responsible for Spotify’s data catalogue, metadata, and data lineage capabilities. In this role, you'll own the strategy and roadmap for a critical part of Spotify's data ecosystem, helping users discover, understand, trust, and safely use data at scale. You'll work closely with engineers, designers, data scientists, and product teams across Spotify to make working with data faster, safer, and more intuitive.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and own the product strategy and roadmap for Spotify's data catalogue, metadata, and data lineage domain.
  • Diagnose and deeply understand the needs of Spotify's data community, including data engineers, data scientists, analysts, ML engineers, and increasingly AI agents.
  • Identify and prioritize the highest-impact problems to solve, balancing user needs, business priorities, platform requirements, and regulatory considerations.
  • Evaluate and deliver solutions through building, buying, or integrating third-party products and capabilities.
  • Define success metrics and KPIs that measure adoption, value creation, and business impact.
  • Build strong relationships with internal product, engineering, analytics, and data teams to understand workflows, gather feedback, and shape future platform investments.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, design, and data science partners to deliver high-quality platform experiences.
  • Influence stakeholders across the Data Platform Studio and broader Spotify organization to align around product direction and priorities.
  • Help shape how Spotify approaches metadata, governance, discoverability, lineage, and trust in an increasingly AI-driven world.
  • Stay informed on industry trends across data platforms, developer tools, AI/ML infrastructure, analytics, and data governance.

Who You Are

  • You have 2+ years of Product Management experience, ideally working on platform products, developer tools, data infrastructure, analytics platforms, or data governance systems.
  • You have a technical foundation through a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, and/or prior experience in engineering or technical roles.
  • You are comfortable working with engineers and can engage in technical discussions while representing customer and business needs.
  • You are an excellent communicator and collaborator who can build alignment across teams with different priorities and levels of technical expertise.
  • You have strong systems-thinking skills and can connect workflows, platforms, users, and business outcomes.
  • You have empathy for people who work with data and understand the challenges they face every day.
  • You enjoy working through ambiguity, breaking down complex problems, and creating clarity for teams.
  • You are curious about how AI is transforming the data landscape and are excited to help shape that future.
  • You lead with humility, build trust through collaboration, and help teams move forward with focus and momentum.

Where You'll Be

  • This role is based in London or Stockholm
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Compensation

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Fully Remote (UK based) | Competitive Salary + Bonus + Generous Equity | B Corp Certified

TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel.

Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world.

We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people.

At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles.

The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you?

The role

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to shape the core experience our members rely on every day across iOS, Android and web.

You'll own the moments that matter: onboarding, listing homes, finding and applying for sits, matching with the right sitter or owner, preparing for a stay. This is a hands-on role as the primary designer in your squad. You'll have real strategic influence over your area's direction and drive measurable impact for both our members and the business.

What You'll Do

  • Design mobile-first experiences that work across iOS, Android and web, respecting platform conventions while staying consistent with our design system
  • Own discovery research and testing for your squad (interviews, usability testing, concept testing) and measure impact using product analytics and qualitative signals to guide iteration
  • Define problems and hypotheses with your squad, choose the right validation method to make sure we're building the right thing for our customers
  • Design AI-powered features for matching, personalisation and communication with trust and transparency built in, and use AI tools daily to speed up exploration, prototyping and synthesis
  • Work with stakeholders across product, engineering, user research, content, data and commercial teams, communicating design rationale clearly to stakeholders, facilitating workshops to create alignment and negotiating trade offs
  • Contribute to and evolve the design system, partnering with Design Systems to create robust, accessible, cross-platform patterns
  • Build solutions that scale. Map journeys and service relationships rather than solving problems in isolation, and champion craft and accessibility throughout

What you'll need

Strategy and systems thinking

Strong systems thinking with experience designing complex customer journeys end to end. Proven ability to set customer-centric vision and translate it into practical, phased delivery while balancing member needs with business goals and technical constraints.

Research and methodology

Hands-on user research skills, confident choosing methods and synthesising insight into clear design direction. Able to frame complex challenges into clear problem statements and testable hypotheses, with solid understanding of experimentation methods and when to use each.

Craft and execution

Exceptional interaction and visual design craft with meticulous attention to detail, including advanced prototyping and working within mature design systems. Deep knowledge of mobile interface guidelines and best practices, backed by a portfolio showing end-to-end, beautifully crafted, user-centred work with measurable impact on customer and business outcomes.

AI in design

Confident daily use of AI-assisted design and prototyping tools as part of your everyday workflow. You'll ideally be working in Cursor, Claude Code or similar for at least some of your workflow and you'll bring ideas of how AI tools can be used to drive efficiency and impact across the design process.

Collaboration and culture

Excellent communication and storytelling skills with comfort working in empowered, cross-functional squads. Experience in scale-ups with strong product and experimentation culture. You'll need to be confident in selling your ideas across the business, creating alignment and inspiring others.

Nice to have

  • Experience designing AI/ML-powered features such as recommendations engines and LLMs with good understanding of the UX challenges they create - trust, comprehension, feedback loops, agency etc.
  • Experience in two-sided marketplaces, subscription or membership businesses, or trust and safety-sensitive products.
  • Self-serve analytics experience (we use Amplitude, Mode) and familiarity with research depository tools such as Dovetail, Chattermill.

Our hiring process

  1. Intro call with hiring manager
  2. Technical portfolio review with PM, Design lead and Engineering partner
  3. Leadership and first 90 days presentation

What you'll bring

You'll own the product design process end-to-end.

At TrustedHousesitters we start with the customer. You'll need to be able to show us how you've used quantitative and qualitative user research to inform your approach to solving product design problems.

You'll feel like a fish out of water if:

We know this isn't what you'd see in most job ads - but TrustedHousesitters isn't most companies.

Trust, transparency, and honest feedback aren't just things we say; they're genuinely how we operate, every day. So rather than leaving you guessing if things don't work out, we'd rather give you what you need to make a great decision upfront about whether this opportunity is right for you.

With that in mind, here are a few things worth considering before you hit apply:

  • Your design experience is web-only - you haven't shaped native iOS or Android app experiences.
  • Your background is mainly B2B, enterprise, or public sector - you're used to solving problems functionally, and this role needs you to think about design emotionally too.
  • You'd rather be handed a fully-scoped brief than help define the problem yourself - you'll be the primary designer in your squad, shaping direction, not just executing someone else's spec.
  • You're sceptical of AI having a genuine place in the design process, or you actively avoid using AI tools in your own workflow.
  • When you disagree with a decision, you tend to raise it and step back - we need people who'll stay in the room and help find the way through.

Compensation

Additional Information

In addition to a competitive salary and bonus, we offer a range of benefits, including:

For the love of pets

  • Each year, you’ll get a Premium TrustedHousesitters Combined membership which includes benefits like free airport lounge passes, Sit Cancellation Plan and Home and Contents Plan, plus five Premium memberships to gift to friends and family
  • Our team can work remotely from as many house sits as they like, and we contribute up to £500 per
    year towards travel costs to and from sits
  • Find a rescue pet to join your family and we’ll cover the adoption fees, as well as “pawternity” to help your pet settle into their new home

Health & wellbeing

  • SimplyHealth healthcare cash plan
  • Bupa Health Insurance and Dental Insurance plan
  • Specsavers eyecare scheme
  • Weekly virtual yoga sessions
  • Optional enrollment onto our Trusted Giving scheme, which includes employee giving via Charities Trust and 2 days paid annual volunteering allowance

Working environment

  • Work fully remotely from anywhere in the world - as long as you follow compliance as a UK tax resident
  • Get £200 to spend on home office equipment each year + Macbook and Apple accessories when you start
  • Access to Spaces co-working locations across the globe
  • We host an all-expenses-paid meetup each quarter and fund team events (remote or in-person) throughout the year
  • We cover the costs of personal development resources and have regular time set aside for learning and growth
  • Depending on your role within the business, you’ll have the option to customise your work hours to better align with your personal schedule

Compensation & time off

  • 25 days off per year, plus bank holidays and festive closure between Christmas and New Year (36 days + Christmas Day for some roles)
  • Competitive salary which is reviewed annually
  • Generous equity package for permanent employees
  • Discretionary 10% quarterly bonus scheme, distributed quarterly
  • Pension scheme: 5% from you as an employee and 3% from TrustedHousesitters
  • £500 recruitment referral bonus

If you're ready to join us on our mission to become the most loved pet travel solution, we'd love to hear from you!

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example- she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

At the heart of our team are a mix of diverse backgrounds. Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re committed to the equal opportunities policy throughout the interview process and selection. Offers of employment into TrustedHousesitters are based solely on individual merit, qualifications, and the person's professional suitability.

Gender identity, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, colour, race, nationality, ethnic or national origins, religion or beliefs, age, mental or physical disability, medical condition, pregnancy or maternity status, or any other protected characteristics do not enter into our decision-making process.
